gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.
'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.
'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.

gaps.sentence: The council rejected plans for a new ___ (DEVELOP).
gaps.explanation: 'A development' = a building project; 'developer' = the company.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.
